message:
Switch deploy email from nodemailer/SMTP to Resend HTTP API

- Gmail SMTP (ports 465 + 587) both blocked by Google for Render free IPs
- Resend uses port 443 (HTTPS) which is not blocked
- Reads RESEND_API_KEY env var; no Gmail credentials needed
- Sends from onboarding@resend.dev, delivers to owner email

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
